## More dependable model downloads
- A download that loses its connection now picks the interrupted piece up again by itself, up to three times, instead of stopping and asking you to press Try again. - A download connection that has slowed to a crawl while the others run fast is replaced. On a slow network nothing is replaced, because every connection is equally slow. - A paused download now stops within about ten seconds even when a connection has gone quiet. - Download speed itself is unchanged: about 360 Mbit/s on a 500 Mbit/s line. The gain is recovery, not speed.
## Models
- The text-only Ornith 1.5 35B A3B builds (6-bit and 8-bit) are no longer offered in the catalog. The vision builds of the same model stay, and copies you already installed keep working.
## Compatibility
- No configuration, REST or command-line changes. - Your models, conversations and settings are kept. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
## Distribution
Astronomical 0.2.108 is signed with a Developer ID certificate, notarized by Apple, and delivered through a signed Sparkle update feed.
